datasetDescription: 20 invented CVs (20 run), 2 roles, 68 requirement rows

labelsProvenance.main: Labels drafted by ChatGPT; reviewed independently by ChatGPT and Claude (agreed on 64 of 68 rows); final decisions approved by Sameer. Not an independent human labelling.

note: Counts, character ranges, verdicts, tokens, latency and cost only. No key, prompt, reply or quote is stored; passages can be rebuilt from the ranges and the CVs in eval/cvs/ (contentSha256 identifies the text the ranges index). Both match modes are scored from the same extraction.

definitions.hit: A verified passage hits a gold passage of the same requirement in the same CV when their character ranges overlap by at least half of the shorter one ("half", the headline) or by at least one character ("any").
definitions.passageRecall: gold passages hit by at least one verified passage / gold passages
definitions.passagePrecision: verified passages that hit a gold passage / verified passages (a verified passage for a requirement with no gold passage is a miss)
definitions.fabricatedQuoteRate: quotes refused as not found in the CV / quotes proposed in a valid shape (refused-as-too-short and over-a-masked-detail are counted apart)
definitions.verdictAgreement: requirements where the pipeline's verdict equals the labeller's
definitions.tierAgreement: CVs where the tier from the pipeline's verdicts equals the tier from the labeller's verdicts, by the application's own rule
definitions.goldThroughMatcher: what the matching stage says when the labeller's own gold passages are the evidence: the matcher's disagreement with the labels before any model is involved

prices: Anthropic list prices, US dollars per million tokens, as given by the owner on 2026-10-15
labelsNote: Scored on 2026-10-15 against the labels as they were before the review of 2026-10-19. The only label changed since is cv-07 / demo-mentoring (partial -> met). This run used the quotes-only prompt (extract-v2), with the matcher alone deciding every verdict.
